strideExempt: legless body: serpent tail, no legs; the rig has no leg chain

tail.behindReason: Model-space trail axis: the body faces -Y (look stamp frontResolved -y), so the Move tail trails +Y, straight opposite travel. The earlier [-0.893, 0.416, 0] was -right of the sprite camera (screen-left in the DEF 2D view), which in 3D put the Move tail 65 deg off the travel axis (in-game 2026-09-30: the tail went diagonal instead of dragging behind).

slump.reason: Death rest: the DEF naga collapses flat onto her coil over the last Death frames (f5-f7 of 8), but the human capture keeps the torso upright, so the delivered Death ended as an upright slump (worker C sheets 2026-09-27: naga tips half over, naga_upg slumps, naga_rani stays upright). Same snake body plan as the Dungeon medusas (tail.behind identical), so the medusa slump knob is reused: dungeon_slump, last 2 Death frames, 65 deg forward.

handSepReason: authenticity lane-A2 2026-10-10 (coordinator: fix the mesh): both main hands rest on the hips and were fused to the hip/coil skin, so any arm motion tore RightHand/RightForeArm|Hips/Tail_00 edges and the hands had to be pinned to the hips (limbIK). Seeds on the mesh fingers below Hand_End (Blender coords); bodyBones gate because the skin is the body colour. Second RightHand entry (no seed) resolves the forearm lying along the waist (149 mixed arm/body vertices) wholly to one side so the contact is cut; hand flood radius 0.1 so the coil skin under the fingers is not flooded into the hand. Seedless LeftHand entry at the left waist contact; armStrip takes the residual heat arm weight off the coil/hip skin under the fingers (below Blender z 0.6 right / 0.69 left, arm share < 0.8) so the face split opens there. splitAll on both finger entries: the fingers are welded to coil skin they were never blended with (pure RightHand corners meeting pure Tail corners), which the reweight-only split left joined, so the CS bake dragged the fingers.

glbPatch.reason: authenticity lane-A2 2026-10-10: (1) 638 tail-coil vertices (ground coil and tail tip) were skinned to LeftHand/LeftShoulder (and a few to the right arm), so coil chunks floated off with the arms in every moving clip; setWeights re-solves them harmonically from the surrounding tail skin over the non-arm bones. (2) DEF intent, now with free main arms (the handSep surgery cut the hands and forearms off the hips and the coil): Hitted knocked back, head thrown, all arms flung out; Death holds her f0 stance facing front (Hips position + rotation), arches back with the head thrown and thrashes side to side, arms flung up, then the existing collapse (f6-f7); AttackFront: arms spread in a rear-back windup (f1-f3), left blade thrust in the lunge (f4-f6, the right arm partly held so its blade does not stretch under the corrective smooth).
